in_sanskrit.name: चांचला
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is always in motion, without stability, unquiet, agitated, disturbed.

in_hindi.name: चांचला
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who is restless, unquiet, agitated, disturbed, wavering, fickle, unstable, always in motion.

in_tamil.name: சாஞ்சலா
in_tamil.meaning: செய்யும் படிவில்லை, கடவுள் அழிவில்லை, கடவுள் அறிவில்லை
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who does not remain in one place, one who does not follow God, one who does not understand God.

in_telugu.name: చాఞ్చలా
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is restless, unquiet, agitated, disturbed, wavering, fickle, unstable, always in motion.

in_marathi.name: Chanchala
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chanchala हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Chanchala is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Chanchal’, which means ‘motion’, ‘movement’, or ‘restless’. It is often used to describe someone who is always on the go, always in motion, and never stays still for long.
